name: Hebbal and Nagawara Lake Restoration
scope: Wetland creation, desilting, new inlets/outlets, walking tracks and water-flow correction across Hebbal and Nagawara lakes; over 21 acres of encroached land reclaimed (10+ acres at Hebbal, roughly 11 acres at Nagawara)
pending: Cost and a specific completion date not confirmed from a primary or directly-verified source (see notes on funding ambiguity).
notes: First GBA-attributed and first drains_lakes record on this site. Corporation set to North as a placeholder (Hebbal/Nagawara are North Bengaluru) — not yet mapped to wards. Funding is unresolved: this project's source (Oneindia, 2026-05-15) describes the Hebbal component as "part of a larger World Bank-assisted lake restoration programme" (which would make it externally funded), while separate, unverified reporting attributes a ₹20 cr figure to the National Disaster Mitigation Fund (a central government fund) for what may be the same or a related work package. Rather than pick one framing, no money_entry is recorded for this project yet — this is flagged as a priority for the next quarterly sweep.
